apps.localizedDescription:
PokeRogueOffline:

A fully offline wrapper for PokéRogue, available on iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux. Play fully offline with local saves, or import your save from pokerogue.net.

Features:

• Fully offline — no internet required after install.

• Exception: Starting a daily run will attempt to connect to this repo, but is not required.

• Local saves that persist between sessions.
• Import saves from your online account.
• Based on the latest main branch of pagefaultgames / pokerogue.

New Features:

• Added a Clear All Data option in Settings → Offline — this deletes all current data. USE WITH CAUTION.
• This is the only offline client that loads the actual server daily seed. Useful when there are special event daily runs.
• Includes the build number in the banner for support reasons.

versions.localizedDescription:
UI/UX:

• The error message that is supposed to show if save loading fails when loading the game while already logged in will now display as intended.

• Additionally, the player will now be logged out if this occurs.

• An error message will now be displayed if an error occurs when attempting to log in with a valid username & password.
• If an error occurs when attempting to load save data while logging in, an error message will be shown and the log in attempt will be aborted.

Files:

• PokeRogueOffline.ipa — iOS (sideload via SideStore / LiveContainer / Feather).
• PokeRogueOffline.apk — Android (sideload by enabling "Install unknown apps").
• PokeRogueOffline.AppImage — Linux AppImage.
• PokeRogueOffline.exe — Windows Portable EXE.
• PokeRogueOffline-x64.dmg — macOS (Intel).
• PokeRogueOffline-arm64.dmg — macOS (Apple Silicon).
• PokeRogueOffline-x64.app.tar.gz / PokeRogueOffline-arm64.app.tar.gz — macOS app bundle, used only by the in-app self-updater (not for manual install — use the DMG for that).
• PokeRogueOffline-{Android,iOS}-ota.zip — legacy combined bundle kept only for installs still running an in-app updater from before the code/assets/locales split; not used by current clients, not for manual install.
• SHA256SUMS.txt — checksums for the sixteen files above (excluding the two -ota-manifest.json files, which carry their own per-channel checksums).
• Build provenance for each binary is attested via GitHub Actions — verify with gh attestation verify <file> --repo PokeRogue-Offline/pokerogue-offline.
